unit:root.title: Tokenizer and word-count modules with explicit contract
unit:root.objective: Own the boundary between the tokenizer module and the word-count module and prove the tokenize(text) contract holds.

outcomes.statement: tokenizer.js and word-count.js work together through the tokenize(text) contract, each independently tested with node:test.

criteria.statement: The two independent modules with their explicit tokenize(text) contract satisfy the supplied goal.

expectedBenefits: Each module is validated on its own with its own node:test file.
expectedCosts: The tokenize(text) export signature has to stay compatible across both modules.

integration.objective: Compose the tokenizer and word-count module changes and prove the tokenize(text) contract holds between them.

unit:tokenizer.title: Tokenizer module
unit:tokenizer.objective: Implement src/tokenizer.js exporting tokenize(text), returning an array of lowercase, punctuation-free words, with its own node:test file.

outcomes.statement: tokenize(text) is exported and returns lowercase words with punctuation stripped.

criteria.statement: tokenizer.js implements and tests tokenize(text) as specified.

unit:word-count.title: Word-count module
unit:word-count.objective: Implement src/word-count.js exporting countWords(text), importing tokenize from tokenizer.js and returning a word-frequency object, with its own node:test file.

outcomes.statement: countWords(text) is exported and returns an object mapping each tokenized word to its frequency.

criteria.statement: word-count.js implements and tests countWords(text), consuming tokenize from tokenizer.js, as specified.

seam:tokenize-contract.specification: tokenizer.js exports tokenize(text): string[], returning an array of lowercase words with punctuation removed. word-count.js imports tokenize from tokenizer.js and uses it inside countWords(text).

rules: The exported tokenize(text) signature stays stable.
tokenize(text) always returns lowercase words with punctuation stripped.
